source_instructions: - PDFScoreBar: `app/` of the portable folder is the complete application source; the builder (`tools/windows_portable/*`, `requirements-cu126.txt`, `assets.json`, `tools/materialize_distribution.py`, `tools/release_candidate.py`) at `builder_source_commit` is `supplemental/pdfscorebar-first-party/pdfscorebar-builder-<commit>.tar.gz`.

- HOMR (AGPL-3.0): `supplemental/homr/homr-457e7c6518a10ba755db2e60883419e56c4d7369.tar.gz` (upstream commit) plus `app/docker/patch_homr_onnx_provider.py` (modification, applied at build time; see `supplemental/homr/MODIFICATIONS.md`) and `app/docker/init_homr_segnet.py` (model initialization).
- PyMuPDF / MuPDF (AGPL-3.0): `supplemental/pymupdf/pymupdf-1.26.4.tar.gz` and `supplemental/pymupdf/mupdf-1.26.7-source.tar.gz` (the MuPDF release pinned by PyMuPDF 1.26.4).

- No LGPL binary is shipped: OpenCV's FFmpeg plugins are removed at build time and TinyCC comes with triton-windows, which the recipient installs from PyPI. setuptools' vendored autocommand 2.2.2 (LGPL-3.0) is shipped unmodified as Python source files under `python/Lib/site-packages/setuptools/_vendor/autocommand/` with its LGPL-3.0 notice and the incorporated GPL-3.0 text.
- All other Python packages are unmodified releases from PyPI / download.pytorch.org at the versions in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
